V39079.label: Target for the overnight rate (business daily)
V39079.description: Also called the policy interest rate, the average rate that the Bank of Canada wants to see in the market for overnight money market financing. (V39079)

V41690973.label: Total CPI
V41690973.description: The total Consumer Price Index (CPI) measures the average change over time in prices paid by Canadian consumers for a basket of goods and services. It is the primary inflation indicator, as published by Statistics Canada and tracked by the Bank of Canada.
